Crushed Red Chilli Flakes for Wholesale and Export

Crushed red chilli flakes add heat, colour and visible chilli pieces to pizza toppings, sauces, snacks and seasoning blends. Tradenest Naturals supplies dried red chilli flakes to food manufacturers, restaurants, spice brands and distributors. We pack for retail, foodservice and industrial buyers, and we handle bulk red pepper flakes orders, private label programmes and export shipments from India. The flakes are made from carefully selected red chillies sourced from trusted growers. We clean, dry, crush and sieve the chillies under controlled conditions. Buyers get a practical ingredient with strong flavour that is easy to handle and dose. The standard product has no added colour, salt or artificial preservatives unless a customer asks for a separate formulation.

Product Overview

Red chilli flakes are coarse pieces of dried chilli, usually with some seeds. They bring a mix of heat, aroma and natural red colour. How hot the final product is depends on the chilli variety, the growing region, the seed content and the grade you choose. For that reason, buyers should agree the heat range and particle size with us before purchase. Tradenest Naturals can supply standard dried red chilli flakes as well as customer-specific grades. Options can include different seed ratios, colour profiles and heat levels. We also take wholesale red chilli flakes orders from importers, distributors, food processors and private label brands.

Manufacturing and Processing

We start by selecting mature red chillies that match the agreed specification. The raw material is then inspected and cleaned. Cleaning removes stalks and foreign matter and gives a more consistent finished product. Next, the chillies are dehydrated to lower moisture and improve storage stability. The dried chillies then go through controlled crushing equipment. Finally, the material is sieved to the target flake size. Each batch is checked for appearance, aroma, moisture, cleanliness and packing condition.
  • Raw material selection by colour, maturity and aroma.
  • Cleaning and sorting before size reduction.
  • Controlled drying for better shelf stability.
  • Crushing and sieving for a consistent flake size.
  • Batch identification for traceability.
  • Food-grade packing for domestic and export shipping.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our standard grade is a coarse flake suited to seasoning and food processing. Values can vary a little with the crop, the chilli variety and the buyer's requirement. We confirm the final specification before production starts.
  • Particle size: 8-16 mesh flakes.
  • Other flake sizes: can be discussed for specific applications.
  • Moisture content: not more than 10%.
  • Physical cleanliness: cleaned and sorted to the agreed specification.
  • Foreign matter: controlled to the agreed product specification.
  • Colour: natural red to deep red, depending on variety.
  • Heat level: set by chilli variety and buyer requirement.
For technical purchasing, we can talk through samples, target flake size, heat level, seed percentage, colour and the rules of your destination country. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, so you can review it before placing an order.

Quality and Food Safety

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and follows documented hygiene practices and standard operating procedures. Our checks cover raw material inspection, moisture control, clean processing, batch traceability and finished product review. These steps help keep supply consistent from one order to the next. Documents depend on the product, destination and agreed contract, so please list what you need when you ask for a quotation. Depending on the order, we can provide the product specification sheet, batch details, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and other export documents. We do not claim certifications beyond our FSSAI licence and IEC registration. You can also share additional requirements before production, such as residue limits, allergen statements or destination-specific labelling. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We review each request and confirm what can be done before the order is placed.

Applications

Crushed red chilli flakes suit recipes that need visible chilli pieces and direct heat. The flakes spread evenly through many dry and wet food systems. They also give products a recognisable spicy look.
  • Pizza, pasta, noodles, sauces and ready-to-eat meals.
  • Pickles, chutneys, marinades and cooking sauces.
  • Namkeen, snack mixes, chips, crackers and extruded snacks.
  • Seasoning blends, spice mixes and instant noodle masala.
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering and foodservice recipes.
  • Private label spice packs and consumer seasoning products.

Buyer Value

Our dried red chilli flakes make ingredient sourcing simpler. A stable dry format means easy storage and year-round production. The product also comes in flexible packing and grade options for different sales channels.
  • Gives consistent heat and even distribution of chilli pieces.
  • Keeps far longer than fresh chilli when stored correctly.
  • Saves preparation time for commercial kitchens and manufacturers.
  • Offers flexible grades for retail, foodservice and industrial use.
  • Supports bulk buying and cost-efficient logistics.
  • Allows private label and customised export packaging.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack the flakes in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. Good packaging protects them from humidity, contamination, light and physical damage. Standard sizes are 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg. Bulk bags and custom export formats are also available. Shelf life is 12 months from manufacture when the product stays sealed and is stored as recommended. Keep it in a cool, dry place out of direct sunlight. Each shipment carries product identification, batch information, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight and storage guidance as applicable.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Samples

The MOQ for crushed red chilli flakes is 5 Kg. Private label printing, custom formulations and special export packing may need larger quantities, which we confirm at quotation stage. Samples of the standard grade are available on request. Lead time depends on stock, the crop season, artwork approval, custom packaging, any testing you request and the order volume. We confirm a dispatch date once the specification and terms are agreed. To request a sample or quote, send us your quantity, target flake size, heat level, packing format, destination country and labelling needs. Our team will reply with availability, pricing and documentation details.

Red Chilli Flakes Price and Export Supply

The red chilli flakes price depends on chilli variety, heat level, crop season, particle size, seed ratio, order volume, packaging, testing and delivery terms. That is why we quote against each buyer's exact specification instead of a single fixed price. As a bulk red chilli flakes supplier India buyers can work with directly, Tradenest Naturals handles both domestic and export supply. We work with distributors, importers, spice traders and food brands looking for a reliable red chilli flakes exporter. Our team coordinates specifications, packing, documents and shipment planning for every order.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Custom or private label projects may need larger quantities, which we confirm when we quote.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. We follow hygienic handling, moisture control, batch traceability and documented quality checks. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer retail, foodservice, bulk, export and private label packaging. Shelf life is 12 months in sealed, dry and protected storage.

What are the typical specifications?

The standard grade is 8-16 mesh flakes with moisture not more than 10%. Other grades can be discussed before production.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Share your quantity, destination, flake size, heat requirement, packaging and documentation needs. We will confirm the sample details and send a quotation.

Standards & references

  • FSSAI: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
  • DGFT: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (IEC registration)
